Onboarding guide

Follow these tips so your application passes checks smoothly without unnecessary back-and-forth.

Accepted documents

PDF, PNG, or JPG up to 5 MB each. Make sure text and numbers are clear and legible.

Common mistakes to avoid
  • GSTIN is 15 characters and PAN is 10 characters.
  • GSTIN state code should match your registered state.
  • Ensure your legal name matches across tax and bank records.
What statuses mean

Action needed: fix a clear typo or re-upload a file.
Under review: our team is verifying details.
Approved: onboarding complete.
